subject: Own the current Kanban patch; review before finishing
body:
I had already begun local changes before the leader corrected the role split. They are uncommitted and must not be trusted as a finished patch:

- `web/src/panes/KanbanPane.vue` has a partial computed-columns and multi-tag change.
- `web/src/composables/useQueryFilters.js` has partial array query support.
- `web/src/stores/board.js` adds a `priorities` getter.
- `web/tests/chat.spec.js` has a fixture test, but it does not yet cover multi-tag URL restore or state reload.

Please review, correct, complete, and own these changes. Do not simply accept them because I wrote them. If any part is wrong, replace it.
